name: Ice Cube Splash
description: Hero product frozen mid-splash with ice and water, hard rim light, dark backdrop. Good for beverages, skincare, glassware.
prompt: {{product}} frozen at the instant of a splash: clear ice cubes and arcing water droplets around it, sitting on {{surface}}, hard rim light with a {{accent}} accent glow from behind, dark seamless backdrop, commercial beverage photography, macro sharpness on the label, natural water refraction, no text, no watermark. {{extra}}
negative_prompt: blurry, extra bottles, duplicated product, warped label, text, watermark, hands

slots.label: Product
slots.help: An Element or an image of the product on a plain background.
